title: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholders with the same geometry as the real content, so the page never jumps.
usage: Match the skeleton to the layout it replaces — same widths, same heights. If the wait passes a second, prefer a spinner with a label instead.
a11y: The placeholder shapes sit inside an aria-hidden wrapper. The container has role="status" and one visually hidden .k-sk-status label ("Loading profile" in the preview) that is read once. The shimmer runs in reverse under dir="rtl" and stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
